desc:
🔱🫧⦘ Welcome to The Reef, a game taking place in an enclosed coral reef where you can become all sorts of animals that inhabit it!

⚔️🦈⦘ Survive the night or become an apex predator!
🍼🐬⦘ Form schools or pods to make you safer!
👑🐋⦘ Unlock cool and rare skins from the store!
🦞🐠⦘ Interact with the realistically behaving NPC prey!
» Join events - New features and limited skins will be obtainable!

⦗⭐ Favorite and like the game for more updates! 🐟👍⦘

--⦗Controls⦘--
Hold Shift - Sprint
Hold Q and E - Up and Down
Hold Space - Horizontal
CTRL - Lock Mouse
1-10 - Emotes
H - Hide UI
Shift + P - Freecam (Private servers)

🏆 Developers: MajorGalah, SharkingAround, IrritatingFish

⚠️ NO AI WAS USED ⚠️
